fields.description: Save-format tag: rev8-logical bytes at 0x00 read ASCII 'GBA YGG ' in samples/baseline.sav (verified with tools/bin_peek.py --rev8). Raw file bytes are the same 8 bytes in reverse order, proving eeprom_rev8 block reversal.
fields.evidence: Logical save offsets 0x00-0x07 decode to 'GBA YGG ' (bytes 71,66,65,32,89,71,71,32) in samples/baseline.sav via 8-byte rev8; boot/init chain FUN_08000278 executes before any save use. Replaces stale raw-domain stub magic.
fields.name: save_format_tag

fields.description: Save-format version string: rev8-logical bytes at 0x08 read ASCII 'ver 1.00' in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.evidence: Logical save offsets 0x08-0x0F decode to 'ver 1.00' (bytes 118,101,114,32,49,46,48,48) in samples/baseline.sav via 8-byte rev8; observed alongside save_format_tag under the FUN_08000278 boot/init chain.
fields.name: save_format_version

fields.description: First word of the zero-default save-data region (fresh battery save reads 0x00 here). Mutable scalar for live emulator testing. Exact gameplay binding is not exposed by this decomp slice, so no gameplay-specific claim is made.
fields.evidence: Logical save offsets 0x10-0x13 read 0x00000000 in samples/baseline.sav; game init path FUN_08000278 zero-fills state buffers (*(undefined1 *)(uVar12 + iVar2) = 0 loop), FUN_08000878 zero-initializes its state block, and FUN_08000a50 zero-fills its target buffer - consistent with all-zero fresh-save defaults.
fields.name: save_data_flags

fields.description: Second word of the zero-default save-data region (fresh battery save reads 0x00 here). Mutable scalar for live emulator testing. Exact gameplay binding is not exposed by this decomp slice, so no gameplay-specific claim is made.
fields.evidence: Logical save offsets 0x14-0x17 read 0x00000000 in samples/baseline.sav; same zero-default init evidence as save_data_flags: FUN_08000278 buffer-zeroing loop, FUN_08000878 state zero-init, FUN_08000a50 buffer zero-fill.
fields.name: save_data_counter

fields.description: Remainder of the zero-filled save-data region (fresh save defaults, 0x00 throughout). Kept as one opaque span because this decomp slice exposes no per-field writers for these offsets.
fields.evidence: Logical save offsets 0x18-0x7F read 0x00 throughout samples/baseline.sav; FUN_08000278 zeroes state buffers at boot and FUN_08000a50 zero-fills a ~0xFF-byte target buffer, consistent with a zero-default save area.
fields.name: save_data_reserved

fields.description: ROM build footer mirrored at the end of EEPROM: rev8-logical bytes at 0x1FF0 read ASCII '2006NINTEN/STING' in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.evidence: Logical save offsets 0x1FF0-0x1FFF decode to '2006NINTEN/STING' in samples/baseline.sav via 8-byte rev8 (raw bytes are the same blocks reversed); nonzero ASCII region verified with tools/bin_peek.py --rev8. No writer for it exists in this decomp slice (only FUN_08000278 boot/init references boot state), so it is mapped as a read-only build tag, not a mutable slot.
fields.name: rom_build_footer

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'GBA YGG ' format tag at logical offset 0 (rev8-decoded; stub's raw-domain bytes were stale)
